parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the DBS instance. This parameter is required. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869853.html operation to view the regions that DBS supports.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869810.html
parameters.help_zh:
DBS地域，该参数为必填项，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869853.html查看DBS支持地域。

更多详情信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869810.html
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The instance class. Valid values:

micro: Entry

small: Basic

medium: Standard

large: Enhanced

xlarge: Enhanced (no traffic limit)

The higher the instance class, the better the performance of backup and recovery. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84372.html
parameters.help_zh:
规格，取值如下：

micro：入门型
small：低配型
medium：中配型
large：高配型
xlarge：高配型（无流量上限）

规格越高，备份与恢复的性能越高，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84372.html
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the subscription instance. Valid values:

Year

Month

指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值如下：

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

If you set the Period parameter to Year, the value of UsedTime can be 1 to 5.

If you set the Period parameter to Month, the value of UsedTime can be 1 to 11
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长，取值如下：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~11

 prepay：预付费（包年包月）
